Mass driver launch gate
is unlocked.<Close>

Citan
"That was the last defense.
The control system is intact.<New>This machine once sent
materials and instruments
toward space. We can fit
the Nanoassembler pod to
one of its rockets.<New>I will set the trajectory.
Elly, start the magnetic
rail."<Close>

Launch gate sealed.
Complete the central control
sequence before leaving.<Close><Close>
